title: Syede Mazloom imame Hussain
body:
SYED-E-MAZLOOM IMAM-E-HUSSAIN, ARSH PE MARQOOM HAI NAAM-E-HUSSAIN
ABID-E-BIMAR SE THA YE PAYAAM, SHIYON SE KEHDENA SALAAM-E-HUSSAIN
KHUSHK HUI KYON NA BATA AYE FURAAT, UTH GAYE JIS WAQT KHAYAM-E-HUSSAIN
PYAAS KO MERI NA KABHI BHOOLNA, AHLE JAHAN HAI YE PAYAAM-E-HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
ASR KE SAJDE MEIN KATA SHEH KA SAR, SHAAM-E-GHAREEBAN HUI SHAAM-E-HUSSAIN
RAH-E-KHUDA MEIN HUE JO SAB SHAHEED, BAN GAYA ISLAAM GHULAM-E-HUSSAIN
AAG NA KYON ARZ-O-SAMA MEIN LAGI, JAL GAYE JIS WAQT KHAYAM-E-HUSSAIN..
